messages:
acme_infra: Hey team — started seeing mixed 403s after last night's SSO onboarding. Generation calls sometimes succeed but embeddings calls return 403, and rerank is failing with the same error. No code changes on our side. Can you help?

maya_g: sorry you're hitting this — can you paste a failing curl and the exact 403 body? also, did you provision via SCIM/SCIM-provisioner or create a service key manually?

acme_infra: repro here. curl:```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXX" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1-large","input":"hello"}'
```
Response for generation (sometimes): 200 ok
Response for embeddings (always):```
{
  "error": {
    "type": "invalid_request_error",
    "message": "insufficient_scope: missing embeddings scope (403)"
  }
}
```

julian_r: thanks, this looks like a classic partial-scope token. Do you know how the key was created? which flow?

acme_infra: created by our SSO onboarding script that calls the SCIM endpoint in our IdP which in turn calls Redwood SCIM. We thought the template grants all three: generation, embeddings, rerank.

liam_s: @julian_r @maya_g can you check idp-bot audit logs? the SCIM sync sometimes maps "vector.access" instead of the newer "embeddings" scope, and old tokens post-provision can end up with mismatched perms.

idp-bot: SCIM event 2026-03-14T02:12:04Z: provisioned service_key id=svc_abc123 for org=acme-corp using template scim-template-2024-09. Assigned scopes: ["embeddings.read", "vectors.write"] (legacy). No 'inference' or 'rerank' scopes assigned.

maya_g: that audit line explains it — the token lacks the inference/generation and rerank scopes. The reason generation sometimes works: you have a fallback system route that routes to a permissive tenant for some calls (race/edge-case), but embeddings and rerank strictly check scopes.

acme_infra: ok, how do we fix without downtime? can we update the existing key?

julian_r: you can either rotate to a new key with full scopes or request a scope patch. For customer-managed SCIM we don't modify keys in-place for audit reasons; we recommend issuing a new key with the correct scopes, update clients, then deprecate the old key.

liam_s: repro steps to validate after rotation: 1) create new service key via Console > Org Settings > API keys and explicitly select scopes: inference/generation, embeddings, rerank. 2) run the curl test for generate + embeddings + rerank. 3) check tokens endpoint: `GET /v1/keys/{key_id}` returns scopes array.

acme_infra: any quick script we can run to list scopes for all keys? we have dozens of services and need to find other partial keys.

maya_g: we can provide a small audit script. Example (console):```
# list keys and scopes via API (supports org-admin token)
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ORG_ADMIN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys | jq '.data[] | {id: .id, name: .name, scopes: .scopes}'
```
If you don't have org-admin, we can run an audit on our side — want me to run it and DM the results?

acme_infra: yes please, that would be great. Also, can you confirm whether SCIM template scim-template-2024-09 is known to be missing generation?

liam_s: flagged to identity team. @oncall-sre can you quick-check the template mapping?

oncall-sre: checking... looks like scim-template-2024-09 maps older scope names (vectors.*) to embeddings only and omits mapping for newer 'inference' and 'rerank' capability flags. We need to update the template and re-provision for new orgs.

julian_r: action plan: 1) maya to run org key audit and DM acme_infra the list of affected service keys. 2) acme_infra to create a new key with the three scopes and rotate clients (we provided curl test). 3) liam to open an identity PR to update scim-template-2024-09 mapping and add a migration runbook. 4) support to keep old key active for 48h after rotation then revoke.

maya_g: I'll run the audit now and DM the CSV. once you create the new key, paste the first_message curl results here and we'll verify. :thumbsup: 

acme_infra: ok creating new key now, will paste results in ~5m

(5m later)

acme_infra: new key created sk_live_newxyz — generate: 200 ok; embeddings: 200 ok; rerank: 200 ok. Verified via the three curl tests. Thanks!

maya_g: great. I'm sending a short remediation checklist to your ticket and will coordinate the 48h deprecation window. Follow-ups: - idp/identity to update SCIM template - ops to consider a proactive scan for legacy-scoped keys and notify org admins - doc update for our SSO onboarding guide to explicitly call out the three scopes needed.

liam_s: PR opened: identity#842 update scim-template-2024-09 to include inference & rerank mapping; migration runbook drafted.

acme_infra: really appreciate the fast help. saved us from a silent-failure in production.

oncall-sre: resolved for now, closing the incident thread. if you see any recurrence ping this channel or open a new ticket. :white_check_mark:
